chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Ideas Danny gives away, and Armstrong Park
summary: Danny says he has promotional ideas for Armstrong Park, and Milt urges him to write down and copyright his ideas.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: That's fabulous. That's a fabulous story. You never heard no more from them.
Never heard no more. I expected that I would see it if they came through here, and I'd say something.
Well, there's nothing to say now.

But it was just a big promotional gimmick that I figured I had something. If it was good enough to sell to him, I could have sold the idea... It's like here they've got a problem with Armstrong's park, how they're going to promote that. They need somebody to help them promote how to put people in that Super-Dome every day. I've got ideas for that, but I keep them to myself.
Well, Danny, just write them down and see if you can copyright them. You must have a publishing company now.

Write them down and patent them. Patent your ideas, so that next time, if anybody comes up with it, yours is dated to show that you had it first. And then, if you want it to be (?), if you want to present it to them, and they don't accept it, and then they later come back and do it, you've got something to identify it with.
You've got a name and you tell them the gist of it, for what it's worth...
Because other people have ideas, too. But that stopped me in (?). Because she told me, you know, "No, don't..."
I'm always... I've got books back there with all kinds of things.
